svg.title: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou — statistician and data engineer, Montréal
svg.desc: A magazine cover: the name Ziyi Zhou as a masthead above a painting of Montréal from the river at dusk on the first frost — Mont Royal and its cross, the lit skyline, the Jacques-Cartier bridge in gold and a winterberry branch. Rare events, honestly measured.
svg.text: I model rare, high-impact events — floods,
financial tail risk, gaps in education data — and
build the software that makes those models
